invalid_gate.gate: Independent end-to-end CUDA replays must be bitwise identical.
invalid_gate.reason: The reference implementation uses CUDA index_add_ for centroid sums. Two executions of the unchanged reference on the same saved values are not bitwise identical, so independent-replay bitwise equality cannot distinguish an implementation change from source nondeterminism.

frozen_replacement_gate.same_intermediate_tensors: Given identical levels, sums, counts, and live masks, the original dynamic assignment and the static torch.where assignment must be bitwise identical, including empty centroids.
frozen_replacement_gate.source_replay_envelope: For each saved production-shape case, old-versus-static centroid maximum absolute error and code mismatch count must each be no greater than 2.0 times the paired old-versus-old replay value.

decision_rule.equivalence_fail: Reject the static-centroid rewrite and do not open the MFU gate.
decision_rule.equivalence_pass_mfu_fail: Do not train; seal the systems result and proceed only to a separately preregistered fused or batched exact-retraction implementation.
decision_rule.equivalence_pass_mfu_pass: Only then authorize the existing compact quality endpoint; do not change codec, cadence, optimizer, or training schedule.
